scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT
    b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk,

    b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,

    p.paciente_key,

    d.departamento_key,

    sc.servicio_cargo_key,

    CASE
        WHEN b.payment_date IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), b.payment_date, 112))
    END AS fecha_pago_key,

    b.amount AS monto_facturado,

    1 AS conteo_transacciones

FROM silver.billing b

INNER JOIN silver.admissions a
    ON a.admission_id = b.admission_id

INNER JOIN gold.dim_paciente p
    ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id

INNER JOIN gold.dim_departamento d
    ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department

INNER JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo sc
    ON sc.tipo_cargo = b.charge_type
    AND sc.estado_pago =
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))) IN ('PAID', 'PAGADO')
                THEN 'Paid'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))) IN ('PENDING', 'PENDIENTE')
                THEN 'Pending'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))) IN ('UNPAID', 'IMPAGO', 'IMPAGADO')
                THEN 'Unpaid'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.payment_status))) IN ('OVERDUE', 'VENCIDO')
                THEN 'Overdue'

            ELSE 'Unspecified'
        END

WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL
  AND b.amount > 0
  AND b.charge_type IS NOT NULL',
